heading: COMMERCIAL DISCLOSURE
subheading: This page is the commerce disclosure for Fresh Market Xchange services to customers based in Japan.
title: Our services include:
sectionTwoContentOne: N&E BLD , Level 6, Ginza 1-Chome, 12-4, Chuo-Ku, Tokyo, Japan
sectionFiveContentOne: We offer a digital product and we do not offer refund after subscription. However, users can cancel the subscription at anytime if they do not want to continue using our product.
sectionFiveContentTwo: Please contact us at info@freshmarketxchange.co if you have any concerns.
sectionSixContentOne: User will have access to the restricted part of our software as soon as payment is successful.
sectionSevenContentOne: We accept all major credit cards and local payment methods.
sectionEightContentOne: Credit card payments are processed immediately, while local bank transfers must be sent 3 days before next invoice due date
sectionNineContentOne: We charge a flat fee of 33,000Y per month for the platform. This fee covers inventory management, Pont of Sale, Online Ordering, Analytics and Insights, and full support. Most future upgrades and changes are also covered and included in the monthly fee.
